  | description = Though it won't open any doors, this golden key serves to remind you of all the good you have done for the people of Eveningstar.
  | notes       = <nowiki />
* Using this item will teleport you to the main plaza in [[Eveningstar]].
* As of [[Update 80]], this item's infamously long 30 minute cooldown time has been cut to 20 seconds to match similar expansion teleport items.
* True Reincarnated characters can use the key to enter [[Eveningstar]] without completing [[Web of Chaos]] quests and [[Beyond the Rift]]. However, these quests are still necessary to flag for the [[Caught in the Web]] raid. See also [[Menace of the Underdark (story arc)]].
